shortDescription: Manage security log profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: application_security
options.description: Configures the system to log traffic to the web application.

options.name: auto_discovery
options.description: Specifies log publisher that the system uses to log Auto Discovered Service/Server events. Defines log publisher as configured on the BIG-IP. If desired log publisher is configured on a different partition to where log profile is created a publisher name must be specified in full_path format e.g. /Foo/my-publisher.

options.name: bot_defense
options.description: Configures system logging of events from the Bot Defense mechanism. When configuring a new profile with C(bot_defense) both C(publisher) and one of C(log_*) options must be specified. When modifying a profile's C(bot_defense) settings at least one C(log_*) options must remain set to C(yes) on the device. In case when during modify operation the device returns an API errors user must consult device configuration to determine if the selected option can be set to C(no).

options.name: classification
options.description: Configures logging of events from the Classification engine.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies descriptive text that identifies security log profile.

options.name: dns_security
options.description: Configures the system to log dropped, malformed, or rejected requests for DNS Security.

options.name: dos_protection
options.description: Defines the log publishers used by the system to log detected DoS attacks.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the security log profile to manage.

options.name: nat
options.description: Configures the system to log firewall NAT events.

options.name: network_security
options.description: Configures the system to log network firewall events.

options.name: packet_filter
options.description: Configures logging of IPv6 Extension Header packet filter rule match events.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: protocol_inspection
options.description: Configures system logging of events from the Protocol Inspection engine.

options.name: sip_security
options.description: Configure the system to log dropped and malformed malicious SIP requests, global and request failures, redirected responses, and server errors for SIP Security.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the security log profile is created. When C(absent), ensures the security log profile is removed.
